system.description:
The mage reads the temporal echoes of a place or object, witnessing events that happened there in the past. At rank 1 the caster senses the flow of time; rank 2 perceives past moments tied to the location. Clarity and how far back the vision reaches scale with successes.

Dice Pool: Perception + Investigation (+1 die as a rote)

Adapted to M5 from M20 Time 2; mechanics paraphrased.
